agenda_text: Seven people, including four American nationals, are killed in a helicopter crash in Samburu County, Kenya
headline: Helicopter crash in Kenya kills seven people including tourists

members.title: 4 Americans die in helicopter crash in Kenya, State Department confirms
Four Americans Dead In Kenyan Helicopter Crash
Four Americans Dead In Kenyan Helicopter Crash | News Radio 830 KHVH
Kenya helicopter crash update: What we know about 4 Americans killed in Mt Ololokwe
Kenya: un hélicoptère s'écrase, sept morts dont six touristes
Pilot and 6 tourists killed in Kenya helicopter crash
Police say 7 killed in safari helicopter crash in a remote part of northern Kenya - WSVN 7News | Miami News, Weather, Sports
Tragédie au Kenya: Hélicoptère avec touristes s'écrase, aucun survivant
US journalist among 7 killed when safari helicopter crashes in Kenya

summary: A helicopter crashed in a remote area of northern Kenya, resulting in seven deaths. The victims included four Americans and other tourists on a safari. A U.S. journalist was among those killed in the crash, which had no survivors.

agenda_text: Merck and Moderna reports that their cancer vaccine candidate showed positive results in their late-stage trial in preventing a recurrence of melanoma, including in high-risk patients
headline: Moderna and Merck Cancer Vaccine Shows Promise in Melanoma Trial

members.title: Cancer Vaccine Shows Promise In Preventing Recurrence Of Melanoma
Cancer vaccine shows promise in late- stage melanoma trial; stocks soar
La vacuna de Moderna y Merck contra el melanoma muestra prometedores resultados en un ensayo clínico
Merck and Moderna say cancer vaccine shows promise – NBC 5 Dallas-Fort Worth
Moderna cancer vaccine cuts melanoma risk in breakthrough trial, shares surge 160%
Moderna e Merck anunciam resultados promissores de tratamento contra câncer de pele

summary: A cancer vaccine developed jointly by Moderna and Merck has demonstrated promising results in a late-stage clinical trial for melanoma, showing effectiveness in preventing the recurrence of the disease. The positive trial results led to significant increases in both companies' stock prices, with shares surging as investors responded to the breakthrough in cancer vaccine development.

agenda_text: At least nine people are killed and six others are injured in a hotel fire in Kolkata, West Bengal, India
headline: At least nine people killed in hotel fire in Kolkata

members.title: Al menos nueve muertos por un incendio en un hotel de Calcuta | Noticias La Tribuna de Albacete
At least nine killed in hotel fire in India's Kolkata
Incendio devasta un hotel a Calcutta: almeno 9 morti e diversi feriti
Kolkata hotel fire: 'The staff were fast asleep'

summary: A fire broke out at a hotel in Kolkata, India, resulting in at least nine deaths and several injuries. According to accounts from the incident, staff members were asleep at the time the fire started, which may have contributed to the rapid spread and severity of the disaster.

agenda_text: Twenty-three people are killed and five others are injured in a head-on collision between a bus and a truck on the BR-373 near Ipiranga, Paraná, Brazil
headline: Bus and truck collision in Brazil kills at least 21 people

members.title: Autobusi dhe kamioni përplasen në Brazil, të paktën 23 persona humbën jetën
Colisão entre ônibus e carreta deixa 21 mortos na BR-373, no Paraná
Grave accidente de tránsito en Brasil deja 23 muertos: eran pacientes que iban en un bus

summary: A collision between a bus and a truck occurred on BR-373 in Paraná, Brazil, resulting in at least 21 to 23 deaths. The bus was carrying patients at the time of the accident.

agenda_text: The Israel Defense Forces (IDF) launches a investigation into troop conduct for their roles in the 2024 killing of five-year-old Palestinian girl Hind Rajab, her family, and 15 other paramedics
headline: Israeli military acknowledges firing on vehicle carrying five-year-old Palestinian girl Hind Rajab

members.title: "The Voice of Hind Rajab": ora sulla piccola palestinese uccise anche l'esercito israeliano apre un'inchiesta
Israel admits that it fired on vehicle carrying five-year-old Hind Rajab

summary: The Israeli military has opened an investigation and admitted to firing on a vehicle that was carrying five-year-old Palestinian child Hind Rajab, according to reports. The acknowledgment came after international attention on the case of the young girl killed during the conflict.

agenda_text: Three people drown and another is injured on a beach near Shoreham-by-Sea, Sussex, England
headline: Three family members die after getting into trouble off Sussex coast

members.title: Three people from same family die after getting into trouble off Sussex coast

summary: Three people from the same family died after encountering difficulties in the water off the Sussex coast. The incident occurred in the sea near the English county, resulting in the deaths of all three family members who were caught in trouble while in the water.

agenda_text: The UK Health Security Agency confirms that an outbreak of salmonella in the UK has left one person dead and hundreds more ill. The outbreak is believed to be linked to imported eggs
headline: Salmonella outbreak in UK kills one person, sickens 200

members.title: One person dies in UK-wide salmonella outbreak
UK salmonella outbreak kills 1 and affects 200 more

summary: A salmonella outbreak affecting the United Kingdom has resulted in one death and caused illness in approximately 200 additional people. The outbreak has spread across the UK and represents a significant food safety incident involving the bacterial pathogen.

agenda_text: British prime minister Andy Burnham confirms that the United Kingdom will continue to militarily support Ukraine after Russia warned the UK will face "consequences" for allowing Ukraine to use British-made drones to strike targets deep inside Russian territory
headline: Russia issues warning to UK over drone supplies to Ukraine

members.title: Russia warns UK over supplying drones to Ukraine

summary: Russia has warned the United Kingdom against supplying drones to Ukraine, according to a report from africaleader.com. The warning reflects Russia's concern about Western military support to Ukraine during the ongoing conflict.

agenda_text: A second earthquake strikes the province of Granada, in Spain. Damage and injures are reported in Granada and the surrounding area, while the Alhambra is evacuated
headline: Granada experiences earthquake with evacuations and injuries reported

members.title: Granada torna a tremare, nuova scossa di terremoto: evacuazioni, danni e feriti

summary: A new earthquake struck Granada, causing evacuations, damage to buildings, and injuries to residents. The seismic event prompted emergency response efforts in the affected area.

agenda_text: Iran says it barred two French embassy employees from returning for allegedly violating the Vienna Convention through activities supporting Iranian civil society. France says their work involved programs for civil society, students, and artists
headline: Iran bars two French embassy employees from returning
summary: Iran said it prevented two French embassy employees from re-entering the country, claiming they violated the Vienna Convention through activities supporting Iranian civil society. France stated that the employees' work involved programs for civil society, students, and artists.

agenda_text: The Constitutional Council of France blocks a bill proposing a ban social media access for minors under the age of 15. President Emmanuel Macron orders prime minister Sebastien Lecornu to re-work the draft legislation and resubmit it to the Council
headline: France's Constitutional Council rejects social media ban for minors under 15
summary: France's Constitutional Council has blocked a bill that would have banned social media access for minors under the age of 15. Following this rejection, President Emmanuel Macron has instructed Prime Minister Sebastien Lecornu to revise the draft legislation and submit it again to the Council for review.

agenda_text: Thai rescuers find a French tourist and his two sons alive after they spend more than 16 hours at sea when their rented jet ski capsizes off Ko Samui. The family receives medical checks and is discharged
headline: French tourist and two sons rescued after jet ski capsizes off Thailand
summary: Thai rescuers found a French tourist and his two sons alive after they spent more than 16 hours at sea when their rented jet ski capsized off Ko Samui. The family received medical checks and was discharged.

agenda_text: A Spanish F/A-18 Hornet jet shoots down a Russian drone in Romanian airspace. The drone was downed near Galați after entering from Moldova
headline: Spanish F/A-18 Hornet shoots down Russian drone in Romanian airspace
summary: A Spanish F/A-18 Hornet jet shot down a Russian drone in Romanian airspace near Galați after the drone entered from Moldova.

agenda_text: Three people, including a teenager, are killed and two others are injured in a shooting in Isla Cristina, Andalusia, Spain. Police investigate the attack as a possible dispute between rival drug-trafficking groups and search for the gunman
headline: Three people killed and two wounded in shooting in Isla Cristina, Spain
summary: A shooting in Isla Cristina, Andalusia, Spain resulted in the deaths of three people, including a teenager, and injuries to two others. Police are investigating the attack as a possible dispute between rival drug-trafficking groups and are searching for the gunman.

agenda_text: Police in Morocco arrest 111 migrants who attempted to enter Spain's autonomous community Ceuta, amidst tightened security on both sides of the border with Spain
headline: Morocco police arrest 111 migrants attempting to enter Spanish enclave Ceuta
summary: Police in Morocco have arrested 111 migrants who attempted to enter Spain's autonomous community of Ceuta. The arrests occurred amid heightened security measures on both sides of the border between Morocco and Spain.

agenda_text: A earthquake strikes the province of Granada in Spain, with damage reported in Granada and the surrounding area, and being felt in Madrid
headline: Earthquake strikes Granada province in Spain
summary: An earthquake has struck the province of Granada in Spain, causing damage in Granada and the surrounding area. The tremor was felt as far away as Madrid.
